entries.Answer: To reset your password, visit the admin office in person with a valid ID card. Alternatively, contact your department administrator for password reset assistance. Online password reset is available through the student portal under Account Settings.

ID cards are issued at the beginning of each semester from the Admin Office. If you've lost your ID card, apply for a duplicate at the admin office with a written application and a copy of your FIR (if lost outside).

Related Questions: How to apply for bonafide certificate?
entries.Answer: Apply for a bonafide certificate through the student portal (Available Downloads section) or visit the admin office. Processing takes 1-2 working days. A fee of Rs. 100 applies.

Subject change is allowed only during the first week of each semester. You need approval from your HOD and the subject faculty. Fill the Subject Change Form available at the admin office or download from the portal.

Related Questions: How to apply for exam revaluation?
entries.Answer: Apply for revaluation within 7 days of result declaration at the Examination Cell with the revaluation form (available at exam cell). A fee of Rs. 500 per subject applies. Results are declared within 2 weeks.

Submit your grievance online through the student portal (Grievance section) or meet your class counselor face-to-face. For serious issues, meet the HOD or the Grievance Committee. Response is provided within 5 working days.
Apply for migration certificate at the admin office after completing your degree and clearing all dues. Processing takes 3-5 working days. Submit your leaving certificate from the new institution.
Request transcript at the admin office. It includes your complete academic record. Processing takes 2-3 working days. Fees: Rs. 500 for first copy, Rs. 200 for additional copies.
